sources.citation: Glottolog 5.3 languoid record loma1258 (JSON + HTML) and sister record teen1242 (Téén)
sources.note: loma1258 has one reference (Mensah & Tchagbale 1983) and no grammar/sketch/phonology; Téén (lor) has Sib 2018 (long grammar, 440 pp), Leenhouts 1983/1978, Person 1975 (SIL discourse/clause studies), older wordlists — all on Téén, not Loma.
Identity only: Loma (Côte d'Ivoire), individual living language; no change-request documents.
Lomakka article is a stub citing only Ethnologue 18; Lorhon article gives a PHOIBLE inventory for Téén (Chanard & Hartell 2019) and nothing on Loma.

sources.citation: Elders, Stefan. 2007. Complex verb morphology in Kulango (Gur): similarities and dissimilarities with Bantu. SOAS Working Papers in Linguistics 15: 187-200.
sources.note: Loma appears only in the group table on p. 187 ('Loma ("Loron") Ivory Coast (around Doropo) 8,007'); nothing on Loma phonology or prosody. Of Kulango (not Loma) it says p. 188: 'a tone system with no lexical tone classes in nouns and verbs' / 'No lexical tone'. downloaded via the Internet Archive (SOAS); note Glottolog's URL for this paper resolves to Maho 2007..
